suite: PS-P1 Quantum-Safe Secure Channel Test Suite

modules.scope: KEM keygen/encaps/decaps, signature keygen/sign/verify, wire packing, loopback transfer, and TCP demo across classical-p256, pqc-L3 (ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65), and hybrid-L3
Automated verification across all 7 adversary scenarios: control, KEM key swap, KEM ciphertext corruption, forged ServerHello, AEAD bit-flips, record replay, and stream truncation
Processor A (5-qubit chain), B (9-qubit sparse), and D (3x3 grid) topology validation, graph metrics, and Qiskit Aer GHZ-5 probes proving 0 SWAPs on Processor D
Platforms A, B, C, D CPU/memory/chunk budgets, JSON configuration validity, and deterministic payload stand-ins (1KB, 100KB, 10MB)
Statistical summarization (median, p95, mean, std), available parameter set checks, and code-size table generation
